title: Support that feels good to share
meaning: Your support can bring joy when it notices the person throughout the journey as well as at the moment of success.
text: Having someone genuinely pleased by your progress can make a demanding task feel less lonely. In the physical position of Anahata, the Empress makes support warm and concrete: cooking, meeting you or arranging a small celebration. The Chariot in energy gives the wish to help each other reach a chosen result. The Sun in emotions brings an open response, a pleasure you can share without complicated explanations. Tenderness can sound like a simple acknowledgement of how much the effort cost, accompanied by the desire to be beside the person enjoying the result.

Suppose you finish something that has occupied several evenings. You leave the phones in another room, bring out the nicer plates and make dinner slightly more festive than usual. **Sharing the joy makes support feel personal.** At the table there is room for funny details, relief and pride in the path taken. You need not measure the importance of the achievement: what matters is the person who wants to tell you what finally worked after so many attempts.

Yet support can quietly become accustomed to a happy ending. When nothing moves forwards, being present feels harder: you encourage more loudly, urge greater speed or find something to praise. Sadness then receives less attention than victory, and may start being hidden. Warmth remains available when care is also recognisable on an evening without good news, before either of you has overcome anything.
